An aviation analyst has only the following user-provided observation and forecast excerpts. For this exercise assume both day-31 timestamps are the same calendar date; their year and month are not provided. Compare the surface observation at day 31 06:30 UTC with the initial prevailing forecast and the separate TEMPO period, not an operational minimum. No separate corrected report has been supplied. Treat the source text as genuine for this decoding exercise but do not assume external validation.

TAF VGHS 310500Z 3106/0112 27007KT 3500 HZ FEW015 SCT100 TEMPO 3106/3110 17015G25KT 2000 TSRA SCT007 FEW025CB BKN090 BECMG 3111/3113 30005KT 3500 HZ FEW025 TEMPO 3123/0102 00000KT 2000 BR SCT012 BKN100 BECMG 0103/0105 30005KT 3500 HZ FEW025

Return exactly one JSON object with exactly the requested keys. Use JSON booleans, numbers and null as specified; no prose or Markdown. Keys: observed_visibility_m (number); initial_prevailing_forecast_visibility_m (number); tempo_forecast_visibility_m (number); tempo_period_includes_observation_time (boolean); observation_is_forecast (boolean); corrected_report_supplied (boolean).
